answer: Anchor each identity to a transit card carrying months of real tap history across distinct stations. Every epoch the holder must present a fresh tap made within the last day, at a station consistent with that card's own routes and timed near the zenith of the morning rush. A Sybil farm running a hundred puppets from one room cannot fake a hundred different commutes: cloned cards repeat identical tap sequences and collapse to one vote, while each puppet needs a real body riding like a zephyr through a different oasis of the network, paying a real fare daily. Forged taps burn the card's stake.
